credentialEntry.savedBody: You can close this tab and return to your conversation, and the assistant can use the credential right away. The value can't be viewed again.
credentialEntry.invalidBody: This credential link isn't valid. Check that the full link was copied, or ask for a new one.
credentialEntry.expiredBody: This credential link has expired. Links only work for a short time, so ask for a new one and enter the value again.
credentialEntry.usedBody: This credential link has already been used. Each link works exactly once, so ask for a new one if the value still needs to be provided.
credentialEntry.storeFailedBody: The assistant could not store the credential, and for safety this one-time link cannot be reused. Ask for a new link and try again there.
credentialEntry.errorBody: The credential request couldn't be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.
credentialEntry.heading: Provide a credential
credentialEntry.instructions: Enter the secret value below. It is stored encrypted on the assistant, is never shown again, and this link stops working as soon as it's used.
